description: This source file defines the 'IOSGatewayChatTransport' struct which implements chat transport functionalities for iOS, including sending messages, managing sessions, and handling events via an external gateway.

classes.name: IOSGatewayChatTransport
classes.description: A struct implementing the OpenClawChatTransport protocol, providing methods for chat session management, message sending, and event handling for iOS.

methods.name: abortRun
methods.description: Aborts a specific chat run session asynchronously by invoking the gateway request with 'chat.abort' method.

methods.name: listSessions
methods.description: Lists current chat sessions with optional limit, calling the 'sessions.list' method via the gateway.

methods.name: setActiveSessionKey
methods.description: Placeholder method intended to set a session as active; no implementation provided.

methods.name: resetSession
methods.description: Resets a chat session identified by sessionKey asynchronously via the 'sessions.reset' method.

methods.name: compactSession
methods.description: Compacts the chat session to optimize storage, invoking 'sessions.compact' via the gateway.

methods.name: requestHistory
methods.description: Retrieves chat history for a session using 'chat.history' method from the gateway.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message in a chat session, logging the event, encoding parameters, and decoding the response.

methods.name: requestHealth
methods.description: Checks the health status of the gateway within specified timeout.

methods.name: events
methods.description: Provides an asynchronous stream of chat-related events received from the gateway.
